coverage.note: Revision 1 of 10.30.6 carries 10.29.8 revision 7 forward and adds the reviewed 10.29.8 to 10.30.6 release delta (delta.json, delta-review.json): two added functions (commerce.price-groups with two SQL checks, orders.bc-invoices with a planned check) and 26 existing functions with released enhancements whose checks are carried over unchanged. No function or check is removed. Existing functions still require target measurement; the carried checks were executed read-only on 10.30.6 hosts (delta.json limitations). Provable without local SQL (an implemented MCP, Admin API or delivery API binding): 63 of 598 checks. Revision 3 implements search.facets.not-analyzed (files-facet-analyzed), search.index-queries.no-constant-macros (files-query-constant-macros) and users.frontend-sign-in.persona-signs-in (dwapi-persona-sign-in) (#246).
